The '''Constable of Homunculi''' was a [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] who served as the leader of the [[Clone Keeper]]s stationed at the [[Clone Labs]] in the [[Emperor's Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].
